subject: Endpoint consolidation: cost scenarios & vendor short list
messages:
From: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.ai>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 09 Mar 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Endpoint consolidation: cost scenarios & vendor short list

Team —

Following up from last week's intake: attached are three cost scenarios for consolidating MDM, EDR, and vulnerability scanning into fewer vendors. I pulled the numbers from finance + vendor responses (see vendor_comparison.pdf). The key things I want us aligned on before we talk to procurement:

- Scenario A: Keep existing EDR + add unified vuln scanner (lowest migration cost)
- Scenario B: Consolidate to single vendor (SentinelEdge) for MDM+EDR+Vuln (higher discount, migration effort)
- Scenario C: Two-vendor split (MDM + combined EDR/Vuln) (middle ground)

Ask: please review the attached endpoint_cost_scenarios.xlsx and flag any hard requirements or blockers by EOD Thu so I can share a recommended path with Finance. If we agree to pilot a vendor, we should aim to start a 2-week pilot in mid-Apr and have procurement/contract scope ready by end of April.

Attachments: endpoint_cost_scenarios.xlsx, vendor_comparison.pdf

Proposed next step: 30m sync Thu 11am PT to finalize the shortlist. If that works, I’ll send an invite.

Thanks,
Sooin Lee
Infrastructure Procurement Manager
Redwood Inference
soojin_lee@redwood.ai
(Attachment: endpoint_cost_scenarios.xlsx)
From: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.ai>
Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 09 Mar 2027 11:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Endpoint consolidation: cost scenarios & vendor short list

Thanks for pulling this together, Soojin. Quick read-through thoughts: 

1) Security must-haves (cannot be compromised):
   - SOC 2 Type II + evidence (last 12 months)
   - Enterprise EDR telemetry retention minimum: 90 days hot, 12 months cold
   - Role-based access controls and RBAC integration with Okta (SCIM + SSO)
   - Support for live incident forensic exports (PCAP or equivalent)

2) Detection/coverage expectations: SentinelEdge's public docs show good coverage on recent threat sets, but I need their AV/EDR detection rates for the last 6 months and a breakdown of telemetry sources (kernel vs user-land hooks).

3) MDM behavior: Any MDM candidate must support remote wipe for macOS and enforce endpoint full-disk encryption reporting.

I can join the Thurs sync but would like vendor technical reps present (SE and at least one engineer) so we can vet the detection and retention claims.

—Marcus
Marcus Lin
Head of Security Engineering
Redwood Inference
(marcus_lin@redwood.ai)

Thanks — a couple of procurement/legal notes so we can align on timeline: 

- Procurement lead time: For a new vendor we should assume 4–6 weeks from SOW to fully executed MSA + addenda (assuming no unusual security attachments). If we are doing a pilot, use a short pilot SOW with clear data handling and termination clauses.
- Data residency / minimums: If SentinelEdge stores telemetry in a third-party region, we need confirmation of where logs are stored (US-only, EU options).
- IP & incident clauses: insist on clear incident notification SLA (1 hour for confirmed compromise) and forensic access terms.
- Contract redlines I’ll push back on: vendor indemnity caps, subprocessor list + 30 days notice, and KMS key separation for cloud-hosted telemetry if requested.

I’ve attached an NDA template we typically use for pilots to speed vendor onboarding — can be used as a baseline.

If we plan to proceed with SE as the single-vendor option, I want procurement to start on the pilot NDA + SOW this week so we hit the April target.

-Lauren
Lauren Bishop
Senior Counsel, Commercial
Redwood Inference
(Attachment: nda_template.docx)

Hi Soojin / Marcus / Lauren —

Appreciate the notes and the scenarios — thanks for including SentinelEdge in the short list. I’m attaching an updated quote (vendor_quote_SE_v2.pdf) that folds in the consolidation discount for EDR+Vuln+MDM and a proposed pilot SOW with a 2-week evaluation period.

Quick answers to Marcus' asks: 
- SOC 2 Type II: we completed our Type II in Nov 2026; I attach the audit reference and can schedule a technical deep-dive with our engineering lead.
- Retention: default is 90 days hot, 12 months cold; we can extend to 24 months cold if required (pricing attached).
- Okta/SCIM: full SCIM + SSO supported; we also provide a deployment guide for Okta integration.

DocuSign link for the pilot SOW/quote: https://docusign.com/SE-quote-DEAL-2027-059

Attachments: vendor_quote_SE_v2.pdf

Let me know what time works for the demo — our engineering lead is available Tue/Wed next week (PST mornings preferred).

Best,

Thanks, Maya — good to see the retention options and the updated quote. Quick internal recap and next steps: 

1) We’ll run a two-week pilot with SentinelEdge focusing on macOS fleet coverage + vuln scan accuracy on our test org. Marcus: please confirm ideal telemetry samples we should provide for validation; I’ll coordinate with Eng to hand over a subset of endpoints.
2) Lauren: please push the NDA + pilot SOW (use attached nda_template as the baseline) and aim to have signatures by EOD Mar 18.
3) Finance: I’ll route the consolidated quote through Finance once Lauren signs off on contract language (vendor_quote_SE_v2.pdf).
4) Demo: Maya — can we lock in Tue 16 Mar 2027 at 10:30am PT for an engineering demo + Q&A? Marcus and I will be there.

I’ll send the calendar invite momentarily and upload the final cost scenario file to the shared drive (link below).

Shared drive: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3c-endpoint-consolidation

Thanks all — moving to pilot is the low-friction way to validate detection claims and the cost model.

—Sooin
